question: If 2x - y = 2 and xy = (3)/(2), then what is the value of (1)/(2)( {{x³} - frac{{{y³}}}{8}} )?
solution:
Given:

2x - y = 2

xy = (3)/(2)

Concept used:

if a - b = n

Then,

a3 - b3 = (n)3 + 3ab(n)

Calculation:

2x - y = 2

⇒ (2x)3 - (y)3 = 23 + 3 × 2xy(2)

⇒ 8x3 - y3 = 8 + 6 × (3/2) × 2

⇒ 8x3 - y3 = 8 + 18

⇒ 8x3 - y3 = 26

By dividing 8 from both sides we get,

( {{x³} - frac{{{y³}}}{8}} ) = ​​(26)/(8)

So, (1)/(2)( {{x³} - frac{{{y³}}}{8}} )=​​(26)/(8) × (1)/(2)

⇒ frac{{13}}{8}

**∴ Required answer is frac{{13}}{8}**.
